content.text: {"claims":[{"claim":1,"text":"Soil pH mapping has been conducted at fine scale in alkaline Vojvodina soils using a rapid ion-selective electrode method for field measurement of soil pH combined with regression-kriging to reduce laboratory costs while maintaining accuracy for management decisions.","sources":[{"id":"SYN-PUB-08251","field":"abstract","quote":"A rapid ion-selective electrode (ISE) method for field measurement of soil pH was calibrated and used to densify a sparse laboratory sample network for regression-kriging in an alkaline agricultural area"}]},{"claim":2,"text":"Rapid proximal sensing methods including portable XRF have been tested for estimating soil potassium and calcium in soil profiles in saline-sodic Pannonian Plain sites, with depth-specific calibration showing improved accuracy compared to a single pooled model.","sources":[{"id":"SYN-PUB-05388","field":"abstract","quote":"Depth-specific calibration equations were more accurate than a single pooled model, particularly below 40 cm"}]}]}
